findings.evidence: Roots.lean:33-34 `tarskiQuery p q = signSum p.roots.toFinset q := (rfl)`; proofs at 39, 45, 53, 58, 66, 73 are each a single `rw`/`simp [tarskiQuery_eq_signSum, <the signSum lemma>]`. `grep -r "tarskiQuery" ./code/TauCeti` → only Roots.lean; `grep -ri tarski ./mathlib` → no hits.
findings.fix: Delete those six and keep only what needs root-specific input: the def, tarskiQuery_eq_signSum, tarskiQuery_zero_left (uses Polynomial.roots_zero) and signCount_roots_pos (uses Polynomial.mem_roots). Callers get the rest by `rw [tarskiQuery_eq_signSum]`.
findings.issue: Six of the eight declarations are instantiation-only restatements of the signSum API: tarskiQuery_eq_sum (37) = signSum_eq_sum, tarskiQuery_eq_card_sub_card (42) = signSum_eq_card_sub_card, tarskiQuery_zero_right (52) = signSum_zero, tarskiQuery_one (56) = signSum_one, tarskiQuery_eq_sum_signCount (61) = signSum_eq_sum_signCount, fullInverse_mulVec_tarskiQuery (69) = fullInverse_mulVec_signSum. Since `tarskiQuery p q = signSum p.roots.toFinset q` is `rfl` (line 34), each is the general lemma up to definitional unfolding, and none has a consumer anywhere in the repo.

findings.evidence: Polynomial.lean:232-235 calls Function.sum_occCount_nsmul directly; Moments.lean:57 shows mulVec_occCount (the base of mulVec_signCount) already calls the same lemma, and Moments.lean:170-172 is the existing pattern for specializing it at `columns := id`.
findings.fix: Derive it from mulVec_signCount (`congrFun (mulVec_signCount Z Q id (fun _ : Unit => e) Function.injective_id (fun x _ => ⟨_, rfl⟩)) ()` plus Matrix.mulVec/dotProduct unfolding), as fullMatrix_mulVec_occCount already does for mulVec_occCount in Moments.lean:170.
findings.issue: signSum_eq_sum_signCount re-proves mulVec_signCount (line 159) from Function.sum_occCount_nsmul a second time. Taking K := ℤ, C := (J → SignType), columns := id, rows := fun _ => e in mulVec_signCount and unfolding Matrix.mulVec/dotProduct gives exactly `signSum Z (∏ j, Q j ^ e j) = ∑ σ, (∏ j, (σ j : ℤ) ^ e j) * signCount Z Q σ`.

findings.evidence: Moments.lean:67-76 and Polynomial.lean:176-192 have the same nine hypotheses modulo the instantiation; Polynomial.lean:146,151 mark signSum_prod/signSum_prod_pow `private`; the four listed line ranges contain the same `Int.cast_*`/`SignType.intCast_cast` simp set.
findings.fix: Factor the translation into one public lemma `(signSum Z (∏ j, Q j ^ e j) : K) = ∑ x : Z, ∏ j, (sign ((Q j).eval x.val) : K) ^ e j` (signSum_prod_pow is currently private, so downstream cannot do this itself), then derive eq_signCount from mulVec_signCount by the same three-line congrArg argument used in eq_occCount, and signCount_solution_pos_iff from eq_signCount plus the existing @[simp] signCount_pos, instead of re-entering the abstract lemmas.
findings.issue: eq_signCount (176) and signCount_solution_pos_iff (196) restate eq_occCount (Moments.lean:67) and solution_pos_iff (Moments.lean:80) hypothesis-for-hypothesis at S := J → SignType, weight := monomial, re-running the identical cast-translation `simp only [signSum_prod_pow, Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_prod, Int.cast_pow, SignType.intCast_cast]` that already appears in mulVec_signCount; that block occurs four times (169-172, 190-192, 211-213, 221-223).

summary: The new abstract moment/inverse material is genuinely new (no Mathlib or TauCeti counterpart found). But the PR stacks three parallel APIs: most of Roots.lean is signSum lemmas re-stated at Z := p.roots.toFinset (defeq, one-line rw proofs), signSum_eq_sum_signCount re-derives mulVec_signCount from scratch, and eq_signCount/signCount_solution_pos_iff duplicate eq_occCount/solution_pos_iff hypothesis-for-hypothesis with the same cast-translation block repeated four times.
